adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new `removeMember` action invokes `self.get("model").removeMember(member)` inside the `bootbox.confirm` callback without returning/handling the promise. In `discourse/models/group.js`, `removeMember` returns a `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` chain with no explicit error handling in this diff. This means failures aren’t handled at this call site (though `Discourse.ajax` could have global error handling not shown here), making it a concrete robustness/UX concern rather than a strictly verifiable broken behavior (the UI also won’t optimistically remove the member, so the admin may still see the member if the call fails).
